rules.description: Applicant must belong to one of the officially notified categories of persons eligible to join CGHS.
rules.user_friendly_explanation: CGHS is mainly for people who work for (or are pensioners of) the Central Government, plus a specific extra list: MPs, ex-MPs, ex-Governors, Freedom Fighters, sitting/retired judges of the Supreme Court, retired High Court judges, Delhi Police (in Delhi), Railway Board employees, and a few other named groups.
rules.pass_message: Your stated category is on the officially listed CGHS-eligible category list.
rules.fail_message: Your stated category does not appear on the officially listed CGHS-eligible category list based on this 2015-16 source; however this list should be reconfirmed on the current CGHS portal since categories can be updated by government order.
rules.verification_notes: Category list confirmed from an official MoHFW Annual Report (2015-16) plus a corroborating official DoT circular and a 2017-18 Annual Report chapter found during research; the CORE list of categories has remained stable across these sources spanning ~2015-2018, but should still be re-checked against cghs.mohfw.gov.in (SRC008) for any newer additions/removals.

rules.description: Eligibility for CGHS medical facilities is determined by the beneficiary's place of RESIDENCE being in a CGHS-notified/covered city, not by the employee's official duty headquarters. This list reflects cities notified as of the 2015-16 Annual Report; more cities have reportedly been added since (see uncertain_information).
rules.user_friendly_explanation: You must actually LIVE in a city where CGHS operates - not just work for a job based there. The list of covered cities has grown over the decades and may have grown further since this data was last checked.
rules.pass_message: Your city of residence was on the officially confirmed CGHS-covered list as of the 2015-16 source.
rules.fail_message: Your city was not on the 2015-16 official CGHS-covered list, BUT more cities have been added since then (a 2026-dated secondary source claims 80 cities) - this must be reconfirmed on cghs.mohfw.gov.in before concluding non-eligibility.
rules.unknown_message: City of residence was not provided.
rules.verification_notes: This city list is CONFIRMED OUTDATED (source is the 2015-16 Annual Report, listing ~25-26 cities). A secondary, unverified source claims ~80 cities as of 2026. See conflicts.json entry CONFLICT_003. Do not treat this list as exhaustive/current in production.
